Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. items.title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
items.summary: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. items.summary: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses. We present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M3OPD-Reasoner), a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs) over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video. items.title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
items.summary: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into N parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. items.title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
items.summary: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. items.title: FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
items.summary: Learned lossless codecs make smaller files than common classical codecs, yet the images we archive and train on still use classical codecs. A main reason is time: a learned codec takes seconds to decode a photo that a classical codec opens in milliseconds, and their faster variants give up most of their gain in size. We argue that much of this time is spent waiting, not computing: the network waits for the values it conditions on, and the arithmetic decoder reads them one at a time. items.title: Glyph: An Interpretability Engine for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery in Clinical Data
items.summary: Automated scientific discovery has the potential to advance understanding of disease mechanisms and accelerate identification of early disease markers. Manual data annotation is infeasible at population scale, motivating methods that automatically extract pre-defined phenotypes in multimodal and unstructured clinical data. items.summary: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads. To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. items.summary: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. items.summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. items.summary: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. items.summary: π^4 is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. items.summary: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate realistic videos, but their heavy computational cost limits broader real-world applications. Mixed-resolution generation reduces this cost by generating the visually important region at high resolution (HR) and the rest at low resolution (LR), yet existing methods suffer a severe quality drop on videos and require knowing the HR region in advance. items.title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: Harness optimization is often studied with a fixed policy model and benchmark. When either changes, the optimizer must decide which parts of an evolved harness to reuse or revise, but the harness alone may not explain why earlier edits were made or how they performed. items.summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. items.summary: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. items.summary: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. items.summary: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. items.summary: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. items.title: 后续：偷头盔的人找到了，头盔耳机拿回，另外赔了 600 元
items.summary: 前情：[一年前给小电驴装的监控，终于派上用场了，成功拍到偷头盔的全过程](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1256357) 后续：**头盔和耳机都拿回来了，对方另外赔偿了 600 元。** 不过，人不是帽子叔叔帮我找到的，我自己投诉顺丰同城联系上的（求人不如靠自己）。 我跟顺丰客服表示不及时处理处理，我就把事情经过发出来曝光，标题都想好了： **“顺丰哪有顺手快。”** （再此鸣谢第一个想到这个标语的 v 友） 当天下午，一个乌鲁木齐的电话打来，一个 20 岁的新疆小伙。 反复念叨：“哥，求你了，帮同事拿的头盔。” 原来他之前就偷过别人的头盔，被关过一次，说第二次就要拘留了。 我跟他说，东西还回来是一回事，我花了五六天找人、投诉、处理这件事，总不能一句“还给你”就结束。 赔偿从 1000 谈到 600 元，我接受了。我也只能多一事不如少一事了，虽然之前设想过 100 中搞他的方案。 目前东西已经完整归还，600 元也收到了。和解及赔偿情况已经向办案民警说明，后续手续等警方通知。 后来顺丰同城给我回访，说会严肃处理。具体怎么处理，我就不跟进了。希望这小伙能记住这次，回头是岸，以后别再顺手拿别人的东西了。
